items.q: What is Meydan Free Zone and who is it suitable for?
items.a: Meydan Free Zone is a leading business zone in central Dubai with full foreign ownership, zero tax, and rapid licensing. Ideal for startups, entrepreneurs, freelancers, and international businesses wanting to establish in the UAE at low cost with maximum freedom.

items.q: Can I open a company in Meydan Free Zone from abroad?
items.a: Yes. The entire process can be done remotely and online — you don't need to visit the UAE. Apply, submit documents, pay, and receive your license online in just a few days.

items.q: What types of business licenses can I get in Meydan Free Zone?
items.a: Commercial, Service, Media, and E-Commerce licenses — covering 1,500+ business activities.

items.q: How long does it take to get a business license?
items.a: Typically 1-3 business days with all documents properly prepared.

items.q: Is physical office space required in Meydan Free Zone?
items.a: No. Meydan offers a Flexi-desk option — perfect for startups and remote businesses.

items.q: How many visa allocations are permitted under Meydan Free Zone licenses?
items.a: Visa quotas depend on your license package and office type. We help you choose the right combination.

items.q: Is it possible to open a corporate bank account with a Meydan Free Zone license?
items.a: Yes. We assist with corporate bank account opening with top UAE banks.

items.q: Can I sponsor family/employee members under Meydan Free Zone?
items.a: Yes. Meydan allows sponsoring family and employees depending on your visa quota.

items.q: What are the document requirements for company setup?
items.a: Passport copy, passport-size photo (white background), 3 proposed business names, and an active email/contact number.

items.q: Why should I choose Setup Zone Dubai for my company formation?
items.a: We offer free consultation, complete document handling, fast license approval, and full post-license support including bank account, visas, and Emirates ID.
